VR.1.2.15.note: Padaccheda, padartha, anvaya and vyakhya correct. मा अगमः (अडागमः with माङ्, against 6.4.74) is rightly labelled आर्षप्रयोगः. Speaker वाल्मीकिः to निषादः matches the sarga map.

VR.1.2.16.note: Correct. The fit_note on वीक्षतः (परस्मैपद शतृ of आत्मनेपदी वि+ईक्ष्, ārṣa) is right.

VR.1.2.17.note: Correct; vyakhya says the speech follows in the next verse. Minor, not an error: the anvaya moves एव from च एव (चैवाब्रवीत्) to वाक्यम् एव; सः मुनिपुङ्गवः च एव शिष्यम् इदं वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् would keep च एव together.

VR.1.2.18.note: Correct. Bold forms in the vyakhya are adapted to agree with वचनम् (पादबद्धम्, अक्षरसमम्, प्रवृत्तम्), which rule 7 allows.

VR.1.2.19.note: Correct; अनुत्तमम् as नञ्-bahuvrīhi unhyphenated per §5.7.

VR.1.2.20.note: Correct. उपावर्तत = उप + आ + वृत् लङ् right.

VR.1.2.21.note: Correct; भरद्वाजः gets the names.json identifier (वाल्मीकेः शिष्यः) at first use. गुरोः taken with पृष्ठतः in the anvaya; acceptable.

VR.1.2.22.note: Second pass: सह now glossed '(शिष्येण) सह, सङ्गे' (समम् removed). Padaccheda, padartha, anvaya and vyakhya correct.

VR.1.2.23.note: Decide स्वयम् प्रभुः (two padas, as drafted; Dharmamitra; printed text has a space; 'the Lord came himself') or स्वयम्प्रभुः (one compound, DCS; 'self-luminous'). The verse already carries seed_disagreement and §5.1 says to flag it. The draft's choice follows the printed spacing and is consistently carried through padartha, anvaya and vyakhya; I recommend keeping it. Everything else is correct (चतुः-मुखः pausal member right; ब्रह्मा given an identifier at first use, though ब्रह्मन् is not yet in names.json).

VR.1.2.24.note: Correct; प्राञ्जलिः unsplit (प्र is not a word on its own) per §5.7.

VR.1.2.25.note: Second pass: vyakhya now reads 'वन्दनं (नमस्कारम्) अकरोत्', one act. Gerunds प्रणम्य, पृष्ट्वा attached to पूजयामास consistently. Correct.

VR.1.2.26.note: Second pass: आसने now glossed 'उपवेशनस्य स्थाने'. rejoin_note (ऋत्यकः 6.1.128) justified. Style only, not an error: आसनम् is still glossed पीठम्; 'उपवेशनस्य स्थानम्' would match आसने.

VR.1.2.27.note: Second pass: आसने now glossed 'उपवेशनस्य स्थाने'. '। ॥' as printed; सति-सप्तमी completed by verse 28, stated. Correct.

VR.1.2.28.note: Second pass: both fixes applied (vyakhya 'सः निषादः **वैरग्रहणबुद्धिः** अपि आसीत्', nominative predicate; कृतम् → आचरितम्). Cross-verse links to 27 and 29 stated. Correct.

VR.1.2.29.note: Second pass: last sentence now 'मुनिः तं कथं जगौ इति अग्रिमस्य श्लोकस्य पूर्वार्धे उच्यते ।', subject named; verse 30 (पुनः अन्तर्गतमनाः … शोकपरायणः) does give the manner. Two इत्युक्ते, one इति आशयः. Correct.

VR.1.2.30.note: Correct. अन्तः-गत-मनाः splits अन्तर् as an independent avyaya, consistent with §5.7 (only non-word prefixes stay joined). Links back to जगौ of 29 and forward to Brahmā's speech (31 ff.) are stated.
